cards.name: Davriel's Shadowfugue
cards.oracleText: Target player discards two cards and loses 2 life.

cards.name: Davros, Dalek Creator
cards.oracleText:
Menace
At the beginning of your end step, create a 3/3 black Dalek artifact creature token with menace if an opponent lost 3 or more life this turn. Then each opponent who lost 3 or more life this turn faces a villainous choice — You draw a card, or that player discards a card.

cards.name: Davriel, Rogue Shadowmage
cards.oracleText:
At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, if that player has one or fewer cards in hand, Davriel deals 2 damage to them.
−1: Target player discards a card.

cards.name: Davriel's Withering
cards.oracleText: Target creature an opponent controls perpetually gets -1/-2.

cards.name: Davriel, Soul Broker
cards.oracleText:
+1: Until your next turn, whenever an opponent attacks you and/or planeswalkers you control, they discard a card. If they can't, they sacrifice an attacking creature.
−2: Accept one of Davriel's offers, then accept one of Davriel's conditions.
−3: Target creature an opponent controls perpetually gets -3/-3.
